<!doctype html>
<html lang="th">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>I See the Light — ASCII Lantern Choice</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--gold:#f8cb82;--muted:#b2a99f}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#08080b;color:#fff;font-family:Segoe UI,Tahoma,sans-serif;min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center}.wrap{width:min(100vw,1280px);padding:18px}.top{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 2px 12px}.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase}.title{margin:5px 0 0;font:500 clamp(18px,3vw,27px)/1.2 Georgia,serif}.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.stage{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 65%,#322119,#101016 68%,#050508);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #44362f;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #0009}canvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}.shade{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#06060990,transparent 24%,transparent 75%,#050507b5)}.badge{position:absolute;left:18px;top:15px;font:10px/1.2 Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#f5d7a1;text-shadow:0 0 12px #efaa57}.loading{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#eed7ae;font:13px Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-align:center}.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 2px 0}.btn{border:1px solid #846849;background:#211a16;color:#ffe5b9;border-radius:3px;padding:9px 15px;cursor:pointer;font:12px Segoe UI,sans-serif}.btn:hover{background:#39291c}.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:wait}.progress{height:3px;background:#332a24;flex:1;cursor:pointer}.fill{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b87839,#ffe0a1);box-shadow:0 0 10px #ffcf86}.time{font:11px Consolas,monospace;color:#c9b89c;min-width:83px;text-align:right}.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#786f67;font:10px Consolas,monospace;padding:10px 2px}.foot .light{color:#cfaa70}@media(max-width:600px){.wrap{padding:8px}.hint,.foot{display:none}.bar{gap:7px}.btn{padding:8px 10px}}

.lanternPrompt{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;display:none;pointer-events:none;background:transparent}
.lanternPrompt.show{display:block}
.promptCard{position:absolute;left:36%;top:52%;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);width:max-content;max-width:76vw;padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid #8a7049;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(8,7,9,.78);box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0008;text-align:center;color:#f5e7ca;pointer-events:none}
.promptCard:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:70%;bottom:-8px;width:14px;height:14px;border-right:1px solid #8a7049;border-bottom:1px solid #8a7049;background:#100e10;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.promptTitle{font:500 clamp(17px,2.3vw,23px)/1.25 Georgia,'Noto Serif Thai',serif;margin:0;color:#fff2d8}
.lanternChoice{--lamp:#ffc66d;position:absolute;left:27%;top:74%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);min-width:94px;height:30px;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--lamp) 82%,transparent);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(8,7,9,.7);color:#fff1d4;font:11px Segoe UI,Tahoma,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;pointer-events:auto;transition:transform .16s,background .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.lanternChoice:nth-of-type(2){--lamp:#ffb15e;left:46%;top:67%}
.lanternChoice:hover,.lanternChoice:focus-visible,.lanternChoice.selected{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12);background:rgba(20,15,14,.9);box-shadow:0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--lamp) 65%,transparent);outline:none}
@media(max-width:600px){.promptCard{left:36%;top:50%;padding:7px 11px}.promptTitle{font-size:16px}.lanternChoice{min-width:82px;height:27px;font-size:10px}}


html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#050508}
body{display:block;place-items:unset}
.wrap{position:relative;width:100vw;height:100vh;max-width:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.stage{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;aspect-ratio:auto;background:#050508;border:0;box-shadow:none;overflow:hidden}
canvas{width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block;cursor:default}
.top,.shade,.badge,.loading,.bar,.foot{display:none!important}
.time{position:fixed;top:14px;right:18px;z-index:30;min-width:0;text-align:right;color:rgba(230,213,181,.78);font:12px Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.04em;text-shadow:0 1px 6px #000}
.lanternPrompt{z-index:5}

.transport{position:fixed;left:22px;right:22px;bottom:18px;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(142,116,75,.25);border-radius:7px;background:rgba(5,5,8,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.restart{flex:none;border:1px solid #846849;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(24,19,16,.82);color:#f2e4c5;padding:8px 13px;font:12px Segoe UI,Tahoma,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.restart:hover,.restart:focus-visible{background:#39291c;outline:1px solid #e7bd77}
.progress{position:relative;flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(205,190,164,.3);cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;overflow:visible}
.progress:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-10px 0;}
.fill{position:relative;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b87839,#ffe0a1);box-shadow:0 0 10px #ffcf86;pointer-events:none}
.time{position:static;flex:none;min-width:106px;text-align:right;color:rgba(240,226,201,.88);font:12px Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.03em;text-shadow:0 1px 6px #000}
@media(max-width:600px){.transport{left:8px;right:8px;bottom:8px;gap:8px;padding:6px}.restart{padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}.time{min-width:88px;font-size:10px}.progress{height:5px}}

.outroScene{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.15s ease,visibility 1.15s;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 55%,#222544 0%,#11172d 38%,#080d1d 72%,#03050c 100%);color:#f5e7ca}
.outroScene.visible{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
.outroScene:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(1px 1px at 8% 17%,#ffe3a4 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 21% 67%,#d7dff7 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 37% 24%,#fff1ce 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 54% 13%,#d7dff7 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 72% 29%,#ffe0a0 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 86% 63%,#e2e8ff 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 94% 21%,#fff1ce 98%,transparent);background-size:460px 340px;opacity:.48;animation:star-drift 28s linear infinite}
.outroScene:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:52%;width:min(72vw,760px);height:min(72vw,760px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,190,102,.12),rgba(178,132,232,.045) 36%,transparent 72%)}
.skyHaze{position:absolute;inset:auto -20% -45%;height:70%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(97,110,184,.18),transparent 68%);filter:blur(24px);pointer-events:none}
.wishLantern{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:50%;top:43%;width:clamp(170px,22vw,265px);height:clamp(250px,38vw,360px);padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);cursor:pointer;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(255,190,94,.22));animation:lantern-sway 5.4s ease-in-out infinite;transition:filter .35s}
.wishLantern:hover,.wishLantern:focus-visible{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 42px rgba(255,198,109,.6));outline:none}
.wishLantern svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.wishLantern .paper{transform-origin:90px 133px;animation:lantern-glow 3.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.wishLantern.launch{animation:lantern-ascend 3.1s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) forwards}
.wishPrompt{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;top:75%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(90vw,740px);text-align:center;transition:opacity .55s ease,transform .55s ease}
.wishPrompt h2{margin:0;color:#f4e4c4;font:500 clamp(22px,3.3vw,34px)/1.35 Georgia,'Noto Serif Thai',serif;letter-spacing:.01em;text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(255,195,112,.22)}
.outroScene.launched .wishPrompt{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-35%)}
.wishMessage{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-46%);width:min(88vw,850px);text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.3s ease,transform 1.3s ease}
.wishMessage.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.wishMessage p{margin:9px 0;color:#f4e4c4;font:500 clamp(22px,3.2vw,34px)/1.55 Georgia,'Noto Serif Thai',serif;text-shadow:0 2px 26px rgba(255,195,112,.2)}
@keyframes lantern-sway{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-1.4deg)}50%{transform:translate(-50%,calc(-50% - 11px)) rotate(1.4deg)}}
@keyframes lantern-glow{0%,100%{filter:brightness(.96)}50%{filter:brightness(1.12)}}
@keyframes lantern-ascend{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1) rotate(0);opacity:1}72%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-155vh) scale(.54) rotate(8deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes star-drift{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(-80px)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.wishLantern{top:42%;width:180px;height:250px}.wishPrompt{top:74%}.wishMessage p{font-size:clamp(20px,5.4vw,27px)}}
</style></head>
